urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to capture. https:// is added if missing.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: One capture per URL per device.

customWidth.title: Custom width (px)
customWidth.description: Adds a custom viewport as an extra device. 0 for none.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: On: the whole scrollable page. Off: what fits in the viewport (above the fold).

format.title: Format
format.description: PDF prints the page as rendered on screen, with backgrounds.

retina.title: Retina (2x)
retina.description: Device pixel density: 2x on desktop sizes, the phone or tablet's own density (3x on iPhone) on mobile. Off: images at CSS pixels, smaller and faster.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.description: Tells the site the visitor prefers a dark color scheme.

elementSelector.title: Capture one element
elementSelector.description: CSS selector of a single element to capture instead of the page, e.g. #pricing or header.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners and chat widgets
hideCookieBanners.description: Hides OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, Didomi, Quantcast and other consent popups, and Intercom, HubSpot, Drift and similar chat bubbles. Nothing is clicked.

blockAds.title: Block ads and trackers
blockAds.description: Blocks the main ad networks and trackers, so pages load faster and ad slots stay empty.

hideSelectors.title: Hide these elements
hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors to hide before capture, e.g. .newsletter-popup.

scrollToBottom.title: Scroll to load lazy images
scrollToBottom.description: Scrolls through the page before a full-page capture so lazy-loaded images appear.

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: When the page counts as loaded.

delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Wait this long after loading, for animations or late content. Max 30000.

maxPageHeight.title: Max page height (px)
maxPageHeight.description: Full-page captures are cut at this height. Endless feeds would otherwise never finish.

concurrency.title: Parallel pages
concurrency.description: Pages captured at the same time. Lower it for heavy pages.

timeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (s)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a page after this long. A failed page is not charged.
